title: Branch breakage: lichen-schc integration tests fail to compile - imports of removed lichen-link modules and missing APIs
description: Found while gating silq (one-line lib-test import fix): cargo test -p lichen-schc --lib now passes (81/81) but the integration tests under rust/lichen-schc/tests/ fail to compile: E0432 unresolved imports lichen_link::identity, lichen_link::link_layer, lichen_schc::link (adaptation_vectors.rs, authenticated_dio_vectors.rs, fragmentation*.rs, link_layer_integration.rs, oscore_roundtrip.rs, reassembly_state_machine.rs, rule*_*.rs); E0433 cannot find link_layer in lichen_link; E0599 no method from_authenticated_dio_frame on AuthenticatedPeerSchcContext and no method accept_peer on FragmentationPolicy<MAX_PEERS>. Last touched by worker4 sync commits (636411fd65, faed8ccfb5); looks like the lichen-link module split / API renames never updated this test corpus. Pre-existing on HEAD (cannot be caused by silq's one-line cfg(test) import). Fix: update the integration corpus to the current lichen-link/lichen-schc APIs or retire tests whose APIs were removed deliberately; coordinate with worker4/nyx7-adjacent work before touching.
close_reason: Root cause: not removed APIs - missing feature declaration. Every API link_layer_integration.rs touches is std/schnorr-gated (lichen_link::identity + link_layer modules and Seed re-export gated on lichen-link schnorr/std; lichen_schc::link module and FragmentationPolicy::accept_peer fragment.rs:366 and AuthenticatedFragmentReceiver::new fragment.rs:2749 and AuthenticatedPeerSchcContext::from_authenticated_dio_frame codec.rs:1892 gated on lichen-schc/std), and every sibling integration test declares required-features in Cargo.toml - but the [[test]] link_layer_integration entry was missing, so plain 'cargo test -p lichen-schc' tried to compile it under default=[] features and failed with E0432/E0433/E0599. Fix: added [[test]] name='link_layer_integration' required-features=['std'], matching the authenticated_dio_vectors convention (std alone suffices: lichen-schc/std = lichen-link/std + lichen-link/schnorr pulls the whole chain; nothing the test uses needs raw-fragment-codec). Verification on heft: --features std runs the target green 7/7; all 14 integration targets green under their required feature sets (adaptation 2, auth_dio 1, frag 14, frag_vectors 2, fragment_generation 0, link_layer_integration 7, oscore_roundtrip 3, rule5/6 6+8+7+8, rule_versioning 5, shared 3); default-features invocation now skips with a clear 'requires the features: std' error instead of a compile failure; clippy --features std --test link_layer_integration -D warnings clean. Note: silq's codec.rs cfg(test) E0599 (worker-6's bead) still breaks the --lib unit-test profile under default features until their one-liner lands - unrelated to this fix. 3x delegated codereview: correctness PASS (all 14 targets re-checked, feature chain closed), security/build-integrity PASS (no CI coverage reduction - CI runs default features where this target never compiled; genuinely std-gated test, not a masked breakage), edge PASS (no cross-package test leakage, no raw-fragment-codec dependency, target name matches stem).
